params.caption: 🎮 Suspect arrested after shots fired near Xbox studio inXile's office A drive-by shooting on Nov 11 hit near an office campus in Tustin, California, on the former Marine Corps Air Station, which houses Xbox-owned inXile Entertainment. Nobody was injured; police found multiple shell casings and say detectives worked around the clock before arresting a suspect. 🕒 Nov 16, 2026 · 18:52 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: GameSpot 👥 @Xbox 🙏 Glad no one was hurt · 💬 Share your thoughts below #inXile #Xbox #GameDev #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
